page_title: FIO 0-0 SAS | Fiorentina v Sassuolo 26/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+4' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Stefano Turati!
90+3' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The statistic for corner kicks – 7:4. Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 12:10.
88' Fabio Grosso has decided to substitute Nemanja Matic and he is replaced by Aster Vranckx (Sassuolo).
88' Substitution. Armand Lauriente makes way for Luca Moro (Sassuolo).
88' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) goes for goal with a shot from long range, but the effort flies painfully wide of the right post.
86' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
85' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders. Sassuolo force their opponents to concede a corner.
84' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards wide of the right post.
82' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

82' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Fiorentina force a corner. They send men into the box.
81' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) has tested the patience of referee Livio Marinelli and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
79' Giovanni Fabbian (Fiorentina) finds a little space near the penalty spot and heads the corner from Albert Gudmundsson goalwards, but the attempt goes miles wide of the right post.
79' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

78' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
75' Paolo Vanoli is forced to make a change. Luis Balbo (Fiorentina) is unable to continue due to injury, Pietro Comuzzo comes on.
75' Luis Balbo (Fiorentina) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
74' Fabio Grosso has decided to make a change. M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo) replaces Andrea Pinamonti.
74' Here's the change. Ismael Kone leaves the pitch and Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) comes on as a substitute.
73' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
72' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 15:10. 4:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
69' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
67' Substitution. Rolando Mandragora is replaced by Giovanni Fabbian (Fiorentina).
66' Paolo Vanoli prepares a substitution. Jack Harrison is replaced by Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina).
65' It is time for a substitution. Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) is on for Cristian Volpato.
64' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes it short.

64' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sassuolo.
63' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.

61' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) controls a neat pass and has options, but decides to shoot from distance. The ball flies towards the bottom right corner, but David de Gea is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
59' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) blows a clear opportunity to score as he rattles the right post from point-blank range.
57' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is given a yellow card.

57' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range low towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
56' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) fires a volley towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but the ball goes well wide of the right post.
54' Stefano Turati blocks a long-range effort from Dodo (Fiorentina) towards the bottom left corner.
52' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.

50' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Stefano Turati to get hold of the ball.
50' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

49' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. Good work from Sassuolo as they win a corner.
47' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) sprays a pass out to Kristian Thorstvedt, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

42' A pass lands at the feet of Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Fiorentina will have an opportunity.

41' Dodo (Fiorentina) serves up a nice cross, but Stefano Turati punches the ball away. A rebound falls to Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
40' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
37' A dangerous towering header by Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
37' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

37' Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) attempts to find Armand Lauriente with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. Sassuolo earn a corner.
35' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) receives the ball in space inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends his first-time shot over the bar.
32' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) is furious with himself as he misses a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.
31' 5:3 – the total goal attempt statistics. The current number of shots on goal is 1:0.
31' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
30' This is a yellow card! Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
29' Ulisses Garcia finds Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) unmarked on the edge of the box, but his thunderbolt of shot goes high over the bar.
28' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) unloads a shot from a long-range free kick that goes harmlessly way wide of the right post.
27' Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
26' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) fires the ball towards the left side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
25' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar.
25' Ulisses Garcia (Sassuolo) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
23' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) tries to find Luis Balbo, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
21' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

20' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the left side of the goal, but Stefano Turati was alert and made an amazing save! Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
19' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
17' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
16' The ratio of the ball possession is 40:60.
12' Dodo (Fiorentina) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.

11' Ulisses Garcia (Sassuolo) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. David de Gea guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.

10' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) sends a long ball forward to Kristian Thorstvedt, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
8' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) tries to find Armand Lauriente with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
7' Jay Idzes (Sassuolo) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.

5' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The game is interrupted now, Jay Idzes (Sassuolo) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
3' Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.

The players are out and the match is about to start. Fiorentina will have the kick-off.
Livio Marinelli is introduced as the referee for today's match.
